content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment is 30-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/M.Tech degree in Metallurgy/Materials Science and Engineering or equivalent with GATE qualification, or an M.Sc in Chemistry/Materials Science and allied streams with Mathematics at the undergraduate level and GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF position at IIT Roorkee primarily involves an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The JRF position at IIT Roorkee is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.
